Name: Zedekiah, Son of Jehoiakim
Summary: Son of Jehoiakim, named beside Jeconiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:16: Son of Jehoiakim, named beside Jeconiah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zedekiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
